descripcion_geo: Ancient region of west-central Asia Minor, divided between the Roman provinces of Asia and Galatia. Colossians and Phrygia are sisters.

historias.titulo: Paul passes through Phrygia confirming the churches
historias.descripcion: On the second journey, Paul and Silas pass through the Phrygian-Galatian region, confirming the disciples.

historias.titulo: Paul in Phrygia on the third voyage
historias.descripcion: On the third journey, Paul passes through the region of Phrygia and Galatia again, strengthening all the disciples.
The letter to the Colossians, written from Rome, goes to a Phrygian church founded by Epaphras.

personajes.descripcion: He passed through Phrygia twice on his missionary journeys.
He planted the church in Colossae (a Phrygian city) and was a faithful teacher of Paul.

personajes.rol: Leader of the church of Colossae
personajes.descripcion: Christian of Phrygia to whom Paul wrote the most personal letter in the NT.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Phrygia: relevant region in the NT world.

mitos.nombre: Phrygia: land of sacred music and heresies

cristianismo.descripcion: Phrygia is famous for its religious music (the Phrygian mode) and was later the land of Montanism (2nd century AD); Paul evangelized her on his travels.
